description: Charts (pdfnative 1.9.0 through pdfnative-mcp 1.8.0): ChartSeries.colors gives one colour per value on the four bar types — a bar chart whose bars are coloured by category (under / on / over target) — while the legend swatch keeps the series colour; a second series without a label is listed as 'Series 2' in the legend (label is optional since 1.9.0). Vector output, deterministic under creationDate.
